notes.title: Release 1st Anniversary Celebration! Digital Deluxe Bundle Now Available!
notes.notes:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43474185/2fd013ab32274fe0b52bb2d123d06b5a56a4117c.png[/img]
To commemorate the [b]1st anniversary since the release[/b] of “Persha and the Magic Labyrinth” we are pleased to announce the launch of the “Persha and the Magic Labyrinth - Digital Deluxe Bundle” which includes everything the game has to offer!


[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43474185/3df765ddf0752f2982afdd252aebd3e2be3efea9.png[/img]
This bundle includes the main game, [u]“Persha and the Magic Labyrinth -Arabian Nyaights-”[/u] along with the "DLC[u] 'Christmas Set' Costume Set[/u]" where Persha and Rock don festive Christmas outfits, and a 25-track “[u]Soundtrack[/u]” that beautifully captures the world of “Persha and the Magic Labyrinth”.

Moreover, this bundle is available at a [b]constant 32% discount![/b] Even if you already own the main game, you can still purchase the DLC and soundtrack at a discounted price.

[b]Let's enjoy the “Persha and the Magic Labyrinth - Digital Deluxe Bundle”![/b]


[h3]＜Bundle Detail＞[/h3]
・Persha and the Magic Labyrinth -Arabian Nyaights-
・Persha and the Magic Labyrinth - "Christmas set" Costume Set
・Persha and the Magic Labyrinth - Soundtrack
